about.title: One clinic, every speciality your smile needs
body: Oral Fresh Multispeciality Dental Clinic was set up in Porur, Chennai to solve a common problem — patients being sent from clinic to clinic for different dental needs. Here, general dentistry, root canal treatment, implants, orthodontics, and oral surgery are all handled in-house, by one team that knows your case from the first visit.

The clinic is led by Dr. Balamurali Sai, who oversees treatment planning across specialities so that patients get one coordinated plan instead of fragmented referrals. Whether it's a routine checkup or a more involved surgical procedure, the same clinic sees it through.
We keep the experience straightforward: clear explanations before any treatment, modern sterilization protocols, and a team that's used to treating first-time and anxious patients with patience.

services.name: General Dental Checkups
services.tagline: Routine care to catch problems early
services.overview: Comprehensive dental examinations, cleanings, and preventive care to keep your teeth and gums healthy, and to catch issues before they need bigger treatment.
benefits: Early detection of cavities and gum disease
Reduces risk of bigger dental problems later
services.recovery: No downtime — you can eat and drink normally right after a routine checkup and cleaning.

faqs.question: How often should I get a dental checkup?
faqs.answer: We recommend a checkup and cleaning every six months for most patients.

faqs.question: Does a cleaning hurt?
faqs.answer: A routine cleaning is generally painless, though patients with sensitive gums may feel mild discomfort.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.tagline: Save the natural tooth, relieve the pain
services.overview: Root canal treatment removes infected or damaged pulp from inside a tooth, relieving pain and allowing you to keep your natural tooth instead of extracting it.
symptoms: Sensitivity that lingers after hot or cold
Swelling or tenderness in the gums
procedure: Removal of infected pulp and canal cleaning
services.recovery: Mild soreness for a day or two is normal; most patients resume regular activity the same day.

faqs.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
faqs.answer: The procedure itself is done under local anesthesia and is generally no more uncomfortable than a filling.

faqs.question: How many visits does it take?
faqs.answer: Most root canals are completed in one to two visits, depending on the tooth and extent of infection.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.tagline: A permanent, natural-feeling replacement for missing teeth
services.overview: Dental implants replace missing teeth with a titanium post fused to the jawbone, topped with a custom crown — a long-term solution that looks and functions like a natural tooth.
symptoms: Loose or failing bridge or denture
benefits: Looks and functions like a natural tooth
services.recovery: Initial healing takes about a week; full integration with the jawbone typically takes a few months before the final crown is placed.

faqs.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.answer: With proper care, dental implants can last 15-20 years or longer.

faqs.question: Am I a candidate for implants?
faqs.answer: Most adults with adequate jawbone density are candidates — this is assessed during your consultation.

services.name: Braces & Orthodontics
services.overview: Our orthodontic program offers both traditional braces and clear aligners to correct crowding, spacing, and bite issues for teens and adults.
benefits: Custom treatment plans for teens and adults
Choice of traditional or clear aligner options
services.recovery: Mild discomfort for a few days after fitting or adjustment is normal; no downtime from daily activities.

faqs.question: How long does orthodontic treatment take?
faqs.answer: Most treatments take between 12 and 24 months depending on the complexity of the case.

faqs.question: Are clear aligners available?
faqs.answer: Yes, clear aligners are offered as an alternative to traditional braces for eligible cases.

services.name: Oral Surgery
services.tagline: Surgical care for complex dental needs
services.overview: From wisdom tooth extractions to more complex procedures, our oral surgery service handles cases that need a surgical approach, performed under Dr. Balamurali Sai's supervision.
procedure: Surgical procedure under local or sedation anesthesia
services.recovery: Recovery time varies by procedure; most patients need a few days of rest for extractions, longer for more involved surgery.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral for oral surgery?
faqs.answer: No — oral surgery is handled in-house by Dr. Balamurali Sai, so no outside referral is needed.

faqs.question: Is sedation available?
faqs.answer: Yes, sedation options are available for more involved surgical procedures.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.overview: In-office professional whitening that lifts stains and discoloration safely and more effectively than over-the-counter kits.
benefits: Noticeably brighter smile in a single visit
services.recovery: No downtime; mild, temporary sensitivity is possible for a day or so.

faqs.question: How long do whitening results last?
faqs.answer: Results typically last 6-12 months depending on diet and oral hygiene habits.

blogPosts.title: What Makes a Dental Clinic 'Multispeciality' — and Why It Matters
blogPosts.excerpt: General dentistry is only the starting point. Here's what a multispeciality clinic actually covers, and why it saves patients time and repeated referrals.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Balamurali Sai
content: A general dental clinic typically handles checkups, cleanings, and basic fillings — anything beyond that usually means a referral elsewhere. A multispeciality clinic is built differently: it brings together general dentistry, root canal treatment, oral surgery, orthodontics, and implants under one team.

The practical benefit is continuity. When one clinic handles your full treatment plan — from a root canal to the crown that follows it, or from a tooth extraction to the implant that replaces it — the coordination between steps is much tighter than when different clinics handle different pieces.
It also means your dental history and imaging stay in one place, so every specialist involved in your care already has full context, rather than starting from scratch.
At Oral Fresh Multispeciality Dental Clinic in Porur, this is the model we've built around — one coordinated plan, multiple specialities, one clinic to visit.
